disposition: Single-job admission with typed concurrent-attempt rejection (also on the public seam), read throttling that limits reads without reordering or dropping records, cancellation leaving no usable partial recovery point, declared-bound refusal past the durable head, and idempotent torn-publish retry are implemented and tested; the gaps are no disabled/unhealthy-member admission (no member concept on this seam), no provider storage-error mapping, and throttling is not visible in any metrics surface.
